blind_real_corpus_negative_challenge.interpretation: supports specificity on observed negative challenge cases; does not estimate positive recall

supplementary_positive_terminology_contr.interpretation: The four accessible controls support positive terminology/context recognition. The two NFSA controls are not assessable because their specific public evidence surfaces were unavailable to the reviewer; this is an access/assessability limitation, not a negative terminology result and not a false negative. These controls do not establish AI presence in any observed archive.

access_methodology.rule: An item may be indexed or discoverable in an archive while its public item page or evidence surface is unavailable. Such an item is not eligible for the MAR archive-AI indicator while public access is unavailable and must not be converted into a negative AI classification.

scientific_decision: Gate 1 is considered calibrated for the current deterministic protocol and may be used to generate candidate observations for Gate 2. No Gate 1 positive may be published or counted as AI use in an archive without Gate 2 confirmation. Gate 2 requires an audiovisual item-level observation, corpus membership, an accessible public item surface and evidence linked to that item.
final_positive_rule: gate1_positive AND item_level_observation AND item_in_observed_corpus AND public_surface_accessible AND evidence_linked_to_item
